usedFor: Copper holds leads and CheckFlow holds checklists, so “New Lead” in Copper can start “Create Checklist” in CheckFlow.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Copper, then “Create Checklist” in CheckFlow
bestTemplate.why: Each new lead gets a checklist built from a template, so the same steps run for every lead.

watchOut: “Create Checklist” in CheckFlow builds from a template, so pick the checklist template first.
